meta.title: Evnelo: events, in motion
meta.description: Open event infrastructure. Publish events, register attendees, sell or give away tickets, message your community and check people in. 0.99% on paid tickets, free events are free, or self-host for nothing.

pricing.title: Lower fees than any other platform.
pricing.body: Most platforms take 3 to 5 percent plus a fee on every ticket. Evnelo takes 0.99% on paid tickets and nothing on free ones. You connect your own Stripe account, so ticket money goes straight to you and never sits with us; Stripe’s processing fee applies at Stripe’s rate, and you can pass fees to buyers or absorb them.

free.title: Free events
free.note: No platform fee, no per-ticket fee, unlimited attendees.

paid.title: Paid events
paid.note: On the ticket price, charged through your connected Stripe account. A $25 ticket costs you 25 cents, plus Stripe.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted
selfHosted.note: Open source. One container, your MySQL, your own Stripe keys. No platform fee, ever.

flow.title: Everything between “I want to go” and “I’m here”.

publish.title: Publish
publish.text: An event page with your cover, schedule, venue and hosts. Public, unlisted, or private by invitation.

register.title: Register
register.text: Ticket tiers, your own questions, guests with their own tickets, discount codes, a waitlist when you sell out.

pay.title: Pay and receive
pay.text: Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Pix. Tickets with a QR code, wallet passes, calendar files, confirmation by email and SMS.

checkin.title: Check in
checkin.text: A scanner that runs in any phone browser, keeps working without signal, and shows the room filling up live.

openSource.title: Your events. Your data. Your stack.
openSource.body: Evnelo is open source under the Apache 2.0 license. Host it yourself with one container and one MySQL database, plug in your own Stripe, Resend and Vonage keys, and keep every attendee record on your own infrastructure. Same product, no platform fee.

points.export: Attendee export and erasure built in
points.providers: Bring your own payment, email and SMS providers
points.ops: Migrations, health checks and backups documented
points.migrate: Moving to or from the hosted edition is a database, not a rewrite

points.rest: REST API for every resource, with idempotent writes
points.sdk: Generated TypeScript SDK and an MCP server for agents
points.webhooks: Signed webhooks for registrations, payments and check-ins
points.openapi: OpenAPI document and interactive docs at /api/v1/docs

cta.title: Make gathering flow.
cta.body: Create your first event in a few minutes. Free events need nothing; paid events need your Stripe account.
